response.justification: The candidate lacks any demonstrable C++ experience beyond early career roles, has no evidence of leading cloud compute platforms or distributed systems at scale, and shows no leadership experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers — all of which are mandatory qualifications for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and open-source contributions with diverse tech exposure
Proven experience in mentoring and conducting technical workshops
Demonstrated ability to own and ship complex, cross-platform projects
concerns: No evidence of 8+ years of C++ programming as required
Lacks experience in cloud compute infrastructure or large-scale distributed systems
No record of technical leadership in cloud or DevOps environments
